name: The Shops at Palm Desert
description: The Shops at Palm Desert is a premier shopping, dining, and entertainment destination in the heart of the Coachella Valley, anchored by Macy's, Dick's Sporting Goods, and JCPenney. This vibrant desert hub offers a rich blend of national brands and unique local offerings, plus more than 15 restaurant options for dining, coffee, or a quick snack.
demographics: The Shops at Palm Desert serves the affluent Coachella Valley market, drawing visitors from Palm Springs and surrounding desert communities with a mix of year-round residents and seasonal visitors. The primary trade area consists of upper-middle-income households (median income $75k+), with a diverse age range skewing toward 45+ adults and retirees who have significant disposable income. Shoppers are drawn to the center's convenient location and selection of national retailers, seeking both everyday shopping needs and dining experiences, with particular strength during the winter tourism season when the valley's population swells with visitors and part-time residents.
